answer: Each agent locks stake behind a hardware-backed kernel attestation binding one identity to one signing key. A weighted draw picks the daily committee at dawn and any member vouching for a twin forfeits the entire bond. Splitting stake across fakes cannot multiply votes because influence grows quadratically, so ten clones post ten bonds for one unit of weight. A validator exposing a duplicate receives the slashed funds as a safe haven for honest work. The attacker pays every locked bond plus wasted compute, while a genuine agent risks nothing.
